visual_review.method: Four sub-composition midpoint snapshots and 19 encoded full-film frames including opening motion, every scene join, product states, caption and final frame; close UI views at 11.8 and 33.5 s. Prior source motion review at 12 fps, including face/hand crops, retained. Sampled visual inspection, not continuous real-time playback.
findings: New purposeful-contact shot appears beneath the existing opening title without covering face or hands. The brief reposition is usable as a work pause in the full edit; exact continuous-trackpad-contact prompt was not achieved.
All four scenes mount and existing UI text, narrative caption and ending remain readable in inspected states.
No new color treatment: warm side lighting and source grade fit the existing orange/cream palette. No skin smoothing or sharpening applied.
Decoded audio is bit-identical to the prior delivered master; narration timing, music and effects are preserved. No new listening review claimed.
visual_review.reviewed_warning: Kite icon intentionally appears in app navigation and message avatar; duplicate image warning is accepted.

limitations: Human pose and hand purpose improve, but brief hand lift and restrained/soft facial rendering remain.
Kite UI is a deterministic illustrative reconstruction informed by product references, not an authenticated product recording.
Cumulative USD remains unknown because original Higgsfield credits and source-image costs are not fully reconciled.
